title: Route node/gateway OSCORE activation through OwnershipRegistry
description: Follow-up to project-LICHEN-v0ee (fix f4b089027c). OwnershipRegistry now enforces exclusive live ownership of directional OSCORE contexts (fail-closed AlreadyOwned on second activation). The bare Context::register_fresh/restore_existing re-exports remain callable and are still used by production activation paths: rust/lichen-node/src/secure.rs:542 register_fresh_context, rust/lichen-node/src/rpl_stack/secure.rs:24, rust/lichen-gateway/src/gateway.rs:1016. Today these are structurally single-owner (contexts.insert(peer_iid, ..) replaces, never duplicates), but routing them through OwnershipRegistry would enforce the contract at the API boundary instead of by convention. Audit note: gateway keys installs by peer_iid prefix while ownership is by ContextId; keep the existing same-prefix guard when wiring.
